text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe's agriculture minister Denis Norman has resigned from both the government and active politics, saying he wants to devote more time to his family.
- A woman in south eastern Zimbabwe stunned a magistrates' court last week by vividly describing how she and five others went around "opening graves and feeding on human flesh at night".
- Nine people died and at least nine others were injured in road accidents which occured throughout the country over the weekend.

- The University of Zimbabwe will provide free food for all first-year students until next Monday while the government processes their outstanding allowances, vice chancellor Graham Hill said on Monday night.
